title: Skyward
description: A pack centered around Create: Aeronautics. Improved world gen / Create & addons / Better visuals
body:
Take to the skies with **Skyward**, a mod pack all about Create: Aeronautics, each mod selected to provide an excellent experience!

  **Features**
- Improved world gen with Biomes O' Plenty and Structory
- Enhanced visuals with Euphoria patches
- Flying ships, boats, and cars with Create: Aeronautics
- More than a dozen Create addons to support your contraptions
